description: This file defines a React component called RangeSlider that provides either a slider or range slider UI element with tooltip support, using the 'rc-slider' library. It manages internal state for slider values and propagates changes via callback props.

classes.name: RangeSlider
classes.description: A React component that renders a slider or range slider with tooltip support, configurable via props.

methods.name: onSliderChange
methods.description: Updates internal state with the current slider value when the slider is moved.

methods.name: onRangeChange
methods.description: Updates internal state with the current range value when the range slider is moved.

methods.name: onAfterSliderChange
methods.description: Calls the external onChange callback after the slider value change is finalized.

methods.name: onAfterRangeChange
methods.description: Calls the external onChange callback after the range slider value change is finalized.
